question: What is the meaning of end of life percentage in relation to efficiency of recycling process?
description: The end of life percentage in relation to the efficiency of the recycling process signifies the ratio between waste materials and reusable and/or recyclable materials generated when a building is refurbished or demolished. This indicator helps evaluate how effectively materials are being managed at the end of a building's life cycle, emphasizing the importance of recycling and reusing materials to minimize waste and promote circularity in construction practices.
